mechanism: Furosemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias when combined with valbenazine, which has dose-dependent QT prolongation potential.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, and perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring to assess QT interval in patients requiring both medications.
